name: CrusherD2's Vencord Plugins
description: Community Vencord plugins you can install from the Plugins tab of CrusherD2's Vencord fork.

plugins.name: DownloadAllImages
plugins.description: Adds a download button on image collages that saves every image from that message.

plugins.name: FriendTimezones
plugins.description: Set a friend's timezone from their profile menu, then see their current time next to their name in chat, DMs, and calls.

plugins.name: SmartAttachments
plugins.description: Compress oversized videos locally and add download links for external file transfers.
requirements: FFmpeg and FFprobe for video compression
